title: Register a PCB stencil and print solder paste
context: Stencil printing prepares motor-controller PCBs for component placement during robot hardware assembly. This scene uses the real Adafruit Motor Shield v2.3 pad layout. The task ends at visible deposit registration and separation; it does not claim reflow, electrical testing or production solder-joint qualification.
setup: One68.58×53.34×1.6mm Motor Shield PCB fixed on a printing bed; one loose125µm steel stencil with117 real apertures, a104×90mm rigid frame and passive PCB-outline registering skirt; an80×25×0.5mm steel blade with25×18×20mm handle. Stencil55g,blade65g;120µL finite paste bead preloaded on the stencil. PCB centre(330,-65,779.7)mm;resting stencil(330,75,791)mm;blade(440,-140,807.5)mm;separate rests.
scoring: Return and release the stencil on its supports and clear the PCB for1s.1.0 requires at least90% of117pads to have75% coverage, every pad at least50% coverage, at least80% of deposit area on pads,and no paste bridges, with at least50mg deposited.0.5 at50% qualifying pads and25mg;0.25 at25% and12.5mg;otherwise0. Interarm collision gives0. Coverage is judged by visible footprint; deposit mass by a1mg-resolution balance. Details in SCORING.md.
fidelity: Original-size apertures use16 native SDF foil tiles; robot,frame and blade move through PhysX contacts. Finite soft volume elements approximate a loaded bead,pressure-dependent filling and adhesion/release; this is not full CFD. A separate132-sphere native test verifies aperture passage only. No workpiece pose writes,frame snapping or timed printing trigger. Custom frame/skirt and material coefficients are engineering approximations.
instruction: Print solder paste onto the PCB pads using the loose matching stencil and squeegee. Register the stencil, spread its preloaded paste through the apertures, then lift it to expose the printed board and return the stencil to its supports. Leave the PCB clear for inspection, with adequate deposits on every pad and no paste bridge between pads.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0/2400 actions/120 s; scripted demo: 1.0/2040 actions/102 s
reset_notes: Fresh fixed reset, original calibrated station. Replace or clean consumed material and restore the documented finite preload before every real trial.
